ce_ability: WIS or INT (player's choice, locked at creation)
concept: With thirteen ships he faced a hundred and thirty-three — he is still outnumbered, and it still doesn't matter.

features.cost_line: Action · 2 CE · Focus, up to 1 min.
features.name: Draw the Strait
features.text: Two anchors within 60 ft of you (≤30 ft apart); the line between them is a **Current Line** with a chosen direction. Crossing carries creatures 10 ft parallel — willing creatures may accept; unwilling make a STR save to resist.

features.cost_line: At initiative 20 · automatic (1 CE to prevent one reversal).
features.name: Reversing Tide
features.text: The line reverses direction automatically at initiative 20 (you may spend 1 CE to prevent one reversal). The direction is always visible — a timing puzzle, not a trap.

features.name: Anchor Ships
features.text: Up to **PB willing creatures** ignore the lines' forced movement and may ride 10 ft along the current for 5 ft of movement, once per turn each.

features.name: Crane Wing
features.text: Open a second Current Line sharing one anchor — a bent channel. An unwilling creature carried across the second line makes a DEX save: fail = carried again and knocked prone; success = stops, stays standing.

features.name: Twelve Against Hundreds
features.text: While conscious hostiles within 60 ft outnumber allies at least 2:1, hostile saves against the lines are at disadvantage and forced movement becomes 15 ft. Ends the instant the condition fails.

features.cost_line: Reaction · at 0 HP while a Current effect is active.
features.name: Do Not Announce My Death
features.text: When you drop to 0 HP while a Current effect is active, your Reaction makes the technique self-sustaining for 1 minute — no Focus required, reversals continue, anchors persist. You take no actions; the lines remain destructible.

l20.name: Noryang: The Battle Continued
l20.text: When Do Not Announce My Death triggers, the self-sustaining current lasts until the encounter ends (not 1 minute), and once while it runs you may take one full turn — action, bonus action, movement — issued through the current itself, before going still. The fleet never knew; the battle continued.

maximum.name: Myeongnyang: The Roaring Strait
maximum.text: Anchors to 60 ft apart, with a 30-ft-wide current zone; the zone reverses each initiative 20. Hostiles entering the zone or starting their turn inside make a STR save — fail = moved 20 ft with the current. Anchored allies ride free and never collide.

title: YI SUN-SIN
